description: Run rules for the held-out evaluation of the frozen CSCN-SEM predictions. Implements config/evaluation_endpoints.json (authoritative, including its 2026-10-21 amendment) and fixes only what that file leaves open. Frozen and committed before any observed response of a held-out target on evaluation cells is read.

inputs.sha256_rule: SHA-256 of the file bytes with CRLF replaced by LF (as recorded by scripts/predict_sem_knockdown.py)

verification.hash: every shard config.json next to a predictions.npz records config_sha256 equal to prediction_config_sha256, which must also equal the hash of config/sem_prediction.json at commit 81a3bd1 and of the working copy; each npz's targets, lam and SHA-256 of reference_cells (int64 bytes) equal its shard config; stop on any mismatch
verification.coverage: models equal the list above; nodes equal the frozen panel order; scaled has shape (6, T, 2, 250); every (model, fold, held-out target, condition, direction) appears exactly once over 5 folds x 2 conditions, with the fold's held-out targets from config/target_split.json; stop on any mismatch
verification.delta: the stored delta equals the delta recomputed from the evaluation expression load (same normalisation; absolute tolerance 1e-6); stop otherwise
verification.constant_predictions: before any observed response is read: per model, condition and target, a prediction is constant if the range (ptp) of the per-unit prediction over the 249 evaluation genes is <= 1e-12; the per-(target, condition) flags of cell_specific_cscn_sem, shared_cscn_sem, cluster_level_sem and local_association_network_sem must equal constant_prediction_expected in results/summary/sem_prediction_structure_targets.csv (targets constant in at least one condition: 2, 40, 4, 0); stop on any mismatch
verification.included_zero: rows with included == 0 are not expected; if any (model, target, condition) row has included == 0, stop and report them (never treated as a zero prediction)
verification.constant_shift: shared_cscn_sem and zero_downstream_baseline: the stored per-cell Fufa shift (fufa_scaled) must be constant over the included reference cells (ptp <= 1e-10) for every target, condition and direction; stop otherwise
verification.fufa_pseudobulk: per model, target, condition and direction, the mean of fufa_scaled over included reference cells must equal w . scaled (frozen Fufa panel weights; absolute tolerance 1e-8)
verification.aim1_scores: outputs/aim1/config.json must equal config/aim1.json except the run fields (argv, run_name, targets_subset) and paths.target_qc, which was renamed from results/summary/phase1_target_qc.csv to results/summary/data_prep_target_qc.csv in commit 39ee64e; Fufa n and mean per (condition, group) from outputs/aim1/scores.csv.gz must reproduce results/summary/aim1_group_summaries.csv (n exact; mean rtol 1e-5, atol 1e-6)

rules.evaluation_genes: the 250 panel nodes minus the held-out target's own node (icpdag.sem_inputs.target_nodes): 249 genes
rules.observed_change: for direction c: mean log1p CP10k (icpdag.sem_inputs.load_panel_cells, whole-transcriptome totals, the same function that produced the deltas) over target cells of calib_fold 1 - c minus the same over NTC cells of calib_fold 1 - c, same condition
rules.predicted_change: scaled[model, target, c, :] from predictions.npz (delta from calib_fold c)

constant.observed: ptp over the 249 genes <= 1e-12; Pearson r is NaN in every version (pre-registered and amended), so the target's pair is dropped and counted in every z test

rules.pearson_z: z = atanh(clip(r, -clip_abs_r, clip_abs_r)); r NaN if either vector is constant
rules.rmse: sqrt(mean((predicted - observed)^2)) over the 249 genes; always defined

combine.directions: per (model, target, condition): z = mean of the 2 direction z (NaN if either is NaN); RMSE = mean of the 2 direction RMSE
combine.conditions: per (model, target): z = mean of the DMSO and Vem z (NaN if either is NaN); RMSE = mean of the DMSO and Vem RMSE

versions.amended: a constant prediction gets r = 0 (z = 0) before combining; used by the primary decision test and every paired test on z (per-condition, secondary comparisons)
versions.complete_pairs: pre-registered NaN rule: NaN propagates, paired tests drop incomplete pairs; supporting

wilcoxon.differences: model - reference (cell_specific_cscn_sem - comparator); a positive z difference or a negative RMSE difference favours cell_specific_cscn_sem
wilcoxon.method_rule: exact iff n_eff <= 50 and d has no zero differences and no ties among |d|; otherwise approx (scipy method 'asymptotic', no continuity correction); decided by our code and passed explicitly, so the recorded method is the one used
wilcoxon.reported: n pairs entering, NaN pairs dropped, zero-difference pairs dropped, n_eff, method, statistic, p
wilcoxon.degenerate: n_eff = 0: statistic and p are NaN

hodges_lehmann.estimate: median of the Walsh averages (d_i + d_j) / 2, i <= j, over all pairs entering the test (zero differences included)
hodges_lehmann.ci: percentile bootstrap over targets: a fresh numpy.random.default_rng(seed) per test, indices integers(0, n, (bootstrap_draws, n)), HL per draw, numpy.percentile [2.5, 97.5] (linear)
hodges_lehmann.scale: z tests reported on the z scale and back-transformed with tanh; RMSE and Fufa errors in native units

holm.rule: step-down Holm adjusted p over the finite p-values of a family; a NaN p stays NaN and does not count towards the family size

medians.main: median over targets with a defined z (NaN excluded; pre-registered rule), back-transformed tanh(median z); number of targets entering reported per model
medians.second: median with r = 0 for constant predictions (amended version), labelled; number of targets entering reported
medians.per_fold: the same medians per fold of config/target_split.json
medians.stratum: the same medians per connected / weak stratum (config/sem_prediction.json weak_targets.connected_targets), descriptive
medians.r_models: Pearson r metrics are not computed for zero_downstream_baseline (pre-registered: RMSE only); the NaN flag covers the other 5 models

rules.coverage: per model and condition, the share of the 56 targets with a non-constant prediction; pooled over conditions, the share non-constant in both conditions (= targets entering the complete-pairs analysis); reported next to the complete-pairs result
rules.nan_flag: per model, the share of targets with NaN pooled z under the pre-registered rule; flagged if > 0.1

noise_ceiling.split: for each of the 100 splits, permute the target evaluation cells and the NTC evaluation cells separately (in that order); half A = the first floor(n / 2) of each permutation, half B = the rest
noise_ceiling.statistic: Pearson r over the 249 evaluation genes between (mean target A - mean NTC A) and (mean target B - mean NTC B); Spearman-Brown 2r / (1 + r), clipped to [-clip_abs_r, clip_abs_r]
noise_ceiling.summary: median over splits per (condition, target, direction); directions combined as tanh(mean of atanh) (Fisher z scale); context only, not part of any test

fufa_secondary.observed: per-cell Fufa scores of the frozen Aim 1 run (outputs/aim1/scores.csv.gz), calib_fold from data/processed/cells.csv.gz; for direction c: mean over target cells of calib_fold 1 - c minus mean over NTC cells of calib_fold 1 - c
fufa_secondary.predicted: mean of fufa_scaled[model, :, target, c] over included reference cells (all NTC cells of the condition)
fufa_secondary.contrasts: KD - NTC in DMSO, KD - NTC in Vem, interaction (Vem - DMSO) = per direction c the Vem contrast minus the DMSO contrast, for predicted and observed
fufa_secondary.error: |predicted - observed| per direction, then the mean over the 2 directions
fufa_secondary.summary: median absolute error over targets per model and contrast; paired Wilcoxon + Hodges-Lehmann on the error difference cell_specific_cscn_sem - shared_cscn_sem per contrast (negative favours cell-specific); no multiplicity correction (none pre-specified)

tertiary.mean_shift_note: for mean_shift_models the stored per-cell shift is constant (verified), so using it equals adding the model's predicted mean shift (as pre-registered)
tertiary.predicted_distribution: for direction c: the evaluation-fold NTC cells (calib_fold 1 - c) of the condition whose stored shift is defined (included); predicted sample = their observed Fufa scores + their own stored shift fufa_scaled[model, cell, target, c]
tertiary.predicted_statistic: statistic(predicted sample, the same included cells unshifted), so dropped cells cannot create a dispersion difference
tertiary.observed_statistic: statistic(target cells of calib_fold 1 - c, all NTC cells of calib_fold 1 - c)
tertiary.error: |predicted - observed| per direction, then the mean over the 2 directions
tertiary.summary: median absolute error over targets per model, statistic and condition; descriptive, no test
tertiary.dropped_cells: number of evaluation-fold NTC cells without a defined shift, per model, target, condition and direction

heterogeneity_calibration.observed_interval: per (condition, target, direction): percentile bootstrap 95% interval of the observed log variance ratio; icpdag.dispersion.GroupDraws with bootstrap_draws, the seed and labels (condition, '<target>|eval<1 - c>') for target cells and (condition, 'NTC|eval<1 - c>') for NTC cells; draws log(var_target / var_NTC); numpy.percentile [2.5, 97.5]
heterogeneity_calibration.flags: per direction: over-dispersion if the predicted log variance ratio > the upper bound; covered if lower <= predicted <= upper
heterogeneity_calibration.row_score: per (model, target, condition): mean of the 2 direction flags (0, 0.5 or 1)
heterogeneity_calibration.rates: over_dispersion_rate and coverage = mean row score over the 112 target x condition rows per model (also per condition); nominal over-dispersion <= 0.025
heterogeneity_calibration.aim1_reference: Aim 1 all-cell estimate and 95% interval of the Fufa log variance ratio (results/summary/aim1_dispersion_contrasts.csv, kind gene) as columns only; no rate or coverage against them

rules.run_guard: the full run requires this file, icpdag/heldout_evaluation.py and scripts/evaluate_heldout.py to be tracked and unmodified in git, records HEAD in outputs/evaluation/run.json, and refuses to overwrite an existing outputs/evaluation/run.json unless --deviation '<dated reason>' is given (then documented in results/summary/evaluation_summary.md)
rules.smoke: --fold f --targets A,B: the same pipeline on a subset, writing only to outputs/evaluation_smoke/; prints shapes, row counts and runtime only
